label: Universal origin bridge is the self-edge sibling plus the distinct-relata clause
meaning: Certified difference (#1598) of the registration universal origin bridge strengthens self-edge origin bridge: for every frame and exercise vocabulary, the universal bridge holds iff the self-edge sibling holds and every origin edge is a self-edge or realized by its source's productive exercise. Premise-free; it compares the two encodings, uses no decidable identity and asserts neither bridge.
